name: patch.get_flex
purpose: Read the fourteen patch text prefixes in the alternate formatter.
side_effects_assessment: Refreshes the existing patch-read RAM buffer; no persistent mutation.
output_completeness: Fourteen padded textual prefixes, not a binary patch dump. Expected empty-current-data output is about 3.6 KiB.

name: job_tracker.get_active_job_tracker

side_effects_assessment: Local data reads and UART output; only normal locks, stack buffers and formatting bookkeeping.

name: job_tracker.get_color_usage_log
purpose: Read the bounded serialized color-usage log.
side_effects_assessment: Local data reads and UART output; only normal locks, stack buffers and formatting bookkeeping.
output_completeness: The serialization capacity is 1024 bytes. The API may return only the entries that fit, even when transport capture is complete.

name: strings.get_string
